lr_findings.title: No LR warmup detected
lr_findings.message: lr starts at 0.1, already 100% of the run's peak (0.1) -- no ramp-up phase visible in the log.
fixes: If the first steps are unstable (see any spike or setback findings near the start), add LR warmup over the first 1-10% of steps.
If warmup is configured but not logged until after it finishes, this may be a logging artifact -- check the logging interval.

lr_findings.message: lr fell from 0.1 at step 0 to 0 at step 120, then rose to 0.0983 at step 230. This can be an intended cycle or restart; the log alone does not establish a scheduler fault.
fixes: If this matches an intended cycle or warm restart, no correction is needed.
Otherwise, check that scheduler state was restored with the optimizer after a checkpoint resume.
Check the scheduler's configured horizon and how often scheduler.step() is called.
